_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Find remote jobs open to a country...

description: Find remote jobs a person can be hired for from a country. Use it for "remote jobs I can get from Vietnam" or "crypto jobs hiring in Brazil". Pass country (name or ISO code). Optional: family (software, data, design, product, marketing, sales, support, ops, finance, hr, assistant, other), type (full_time, part_time, contract, internship), niche (crypto, ai, startup, nonprofit, academia, government), keywords, only_open, limit (default 10, max 25). Returns jobs newest first with open ones before unclear ones: title, company, verdict (open or unclear), a reason quoting the post, apply link, date, family, type, niches, location, salary, page link, source to credit, and with keywords matched (where each whole word was found). Jobs whose post rules the country out are never returned. Daily index of public job boards and feeds.

country.description: The country the user would work from, as a name or 2-letter ISO code, such as "Vietnam" or "VN".

family.description: Role family, only when the user named a kind of work.

keywords.description: Up to 5 words that must all appear as whole words in the job, such as "react typescript". Each job then names where in matched.

limit.description: How many jobs, 1 to 25. Defaults to 10.

niche.description: Only when the user asked for crypto/web3, AI, startup, nonprofit, academia or government jobs.

only_open.description: True to leave out unclear jobs and return only jobs whose post includes the country.

type.description: Job type, only when the user asked for one.

name: find_remote_jobs

matched.description: With keywords: each keyword, the field it was found in and the text around it

title: Find remote jobs open to a country
